authorization: Root authorizes continuous read-only ROUTE/TABLE cases with the same model/session/fixture boundary; this plan stays within that scope.
scope: No new resources, server writes, Task/Run/User/Group/Node/Agent/Script create/edit/delete, execution, upload, token change or shared origin. Reuse existing dedicated browser/profile and exact tunnel.

cases.branch: missing Agent detail ID then recovery
cases.actions: API GET the fresh UUID first and require 404; direct-open UI route, observe GET404/NotFound; recover by actual href observed in /agents list and verify GET200.
cases.oracles: Only URL pattern/status/alert boolean/message class; actual row href supplies recovery id; no agent controls activated.

cases.branch: missing Node detail ID then recovery
cases.actions: API GET fresh UUID first and require 404; direct-open UI route and verify error feedback; recover to exact existing detail href ID observed from current Nodes row.
cases.oracles: GET statuses, detail header match boolean, error state and recovery UI; no Node writes.

cases.branch: no live Group fixture; missing detail behavior only
cases.actions: Confirm actual GET /api/groups count0; use a fresh UUID for authenticated GET404 then direct UI route; return to real empty /groups list.
cases.oracles: Route error/NotFound, GET404, list recovery. Mark PARTIAL because there is no live owned Group detail ID to exercise.

cases.actions: Direct-open, refresh, back/forward; inspect only control counts/default/required state; never save.
cases.oracles: Actual GET statuses, ready/error feedback, zero write requests.

cases.actions: Discover one live artifact ID from an actual UI link; direct-open with that exact ID, refresh/back/forward; no save. If no safe live ID, mark PARTIAL.
cases.oracles: Artifact preselection state/count boolean, GET status, route query presence; no artifact body or app data saved.

cases.actions: Open actual live row href and verify GET200; preflight a separate fresh UUID GET404, open the missing detail UI, then recover to the exact actual href.
cases.oracles: Detail ready/error state, GET statuses, ID match booleans, no app data values saved.

cases.actions: Direct-open, refresh, back/forward; inspect form control counts only; do not create/upload.
cases.oracles: Actual GET status and form ready/validation state, zero POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE.

cases.branch: missing Execution ID then recovery to retained owned Execution
cases.actions: Authenticated GET fresh UUID first and require 404; direct-open UI route and observe GET404/error UI; recover to retained owned Execution and verify status/log line count only.
cases.oracles: GET statuses, error feedback, restored exact owned route, no logs/command text saved.

cases.actions: Hide a safe column through actual View menu; refresh and confirm absent; restore visibility and refresh.
cases.oracles: Header/cell presence booleans, 565-row API count, local preference only; zero server writes.

cases.actions: Set actual pageSize=20, refresh, then use actual Next/Previous/Last/First controls and finally restore pageSize=10.
cases.oracles: GET page parameters/status/count, visible row counts, safe hashes of ordered execution IDs to prove page changes and restoration; never store task labels or outputs.

data_handling.audit/execution/application: Only status/count/hash/booleans; no raw bodies, commands, logs, user or app values.
data_handling.missing_ids: Generate fresh local UUIDs only for safe GET404 checks; never POST them or create objects.
data_handling.route_ids: Any valid detail ID comes from an actual current list href or retained owned Execution; never guess or interchange route parameter IDs.
